藏品名称_EN: retable (the pentecost) of the altar of the chapel of the order of the holy spirit chapel of the order of the holy spirit. paris, 1585-1587. the embroidered decoration was carried out in 1585-1587 by claude de luz, the king's ordinary embroiderer. other cl no. 18550 the ornaments intended for the ceremonies of the order of the holy esorit founded in 1578 by henri iii, king of france and poland, were executed in a gold lamé fabric on a green background delivered in 1585 by pierre le grand and macé papillon, merchants supplying the king's silverware.
藏品名称_ZN: retable (the pentecost) from the altar of the chapel of the order of the holy spirit礼拜堂里的圣灵的秩序。 巴黎，1585-1587。 刺绣装饰是在1585-1587年由国王的普通刺绣师克劳德-德-卢斯制作的。 其他CL No.18550 由法国和波兰国王亨利三世于1578年建立的神圣埃索里特教团的仪式上使用的装饰品，是由为国王提供银器的商人Pierre le Grand和Macé Papillon于1585年交付的绿色背景上的层压金帆布。
